svg.title: From requests and KV blocks to one forward step
svg.desc: In EngineCore, each Request knows how many tokens it already computed, req_to_blocks maps the request ID to its block IDs, and BlockPool holds the block metadata. The scheduler sends the number of tokens for each request and the new block IDs in SchedulerOutput. The worker builds input_ids, positions, query_start_loc and seq_lens from those counts, and keeps the block IDs in BlockTables. slot_mapping combines each token position with its block table row. A block ID is the index of the block in the KV cache tensor, so block 9 holds slots 144 to 159 and block 4 holds slots 64 to 79.

g.text: block IDs of each request, in order
KV cache tensor per layer · [num_blocks, heads, 16, 2 × head_size] · same block IDs in every layer
